covariates.partial: final round that ended early (rate in a short round incl. the finishing sequence)
covariates.D10: head sig strikes absorbed in earlier rounds, per 10
covariates.K_lag: knockdowns absorbed in the previous round
covariates.K_early: knockdowns absorbed before the previous round
covariates.A100: own sig attempts in earlier rounds, per 100 (fatigue proxy)
covariates.oA100: opponent's sig attempts in earlier rounds, per 100
covariates.octrl_m: minutes controlled by the opponent in earlier rounds
covariates.ctrl_m: minutes in control of the opponent in earlier rounds
covariates.H10: head sig strikes landed on the opponent in earlier rounds, per 10
covariates.Ks_lag: knockdowns scored in the previous round
covariates.Ks_early: knockdowns scored before the previous round
covariates.lost: lost the previous round on sig strikes landed (tie 0.5)
covariates.behind2_final: final scheduled round and down 2+ rounds on sig-landed rounds
covariates.lostJ: share of judges who gave the previous round to the opponent (decisions only)

dist.outcome: distance sig attempts per minute of non-control time (log)

tda.outcome: takedown attempts per minute (Poisson, gamma frailty per fighter-fight)

fighter_late_ratio.definition: LR = mean over full rounds 2..T of log(sig per min) minus round-1 log(sig per min), each relative to the league (format, round) mean from 2019-2023; fighter-fights with at least two full rounds; LRa = attempts, LRl = landed
